title: Rabbi Netanel
author: Aharon Hyman

paragraphs: He is mentioned in [Pirkei DeRabbi Eliezer, chapter 17](https://www.sefaria.org/Pirkei_DeRabbi_Eliezer.17.14), where he said: “Three hundred years before Josiah was born, his name was named.” In [chapter 25](https://www.sefaria.org/Pirkei_DeRabbi_Eliezer.25.5) he is mentioned after Rabbi Yehoshua ben Korcha. In [chapter 48](https://www.sefaria.org/Pirkei_DeRabbi_Eliezer.48.7) he said: “Moses’ parents saw that his appearance was like an angel’s; they circumcised him at eight days and named him Yekutiel.” Rabbi Shimon says: “They named him Tov.” From this we see that he lived in the time of the tannaim.[^1][^2]

notes.text: Tov (‘good’) and Yekutiel are personal names.

In the Sefaria Vocalized Edition, Netanel precedes Rabbi Yehoshua ben Korcha in chapter 25; Hyman places him after. The Moses naming passage in chapter 48 begins simply ‘Rabbi,’ without Netanel’s name.
